# AutomatedAssessmentFramework

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted

## Definition
A pipeline that automates the comparison of spiking neuron models against biological reference data using algorithmic scoring. Reduces manual tuning effort in neuromorphic design, accelerating the development of biologically plausible computing substrates.
